prompt: Break this work down into tickets our developers can pick up. First look at the codebase, then give me the tickets.
spec: Current situation: users have a single role (admin, editor, reader), see src/Auth/User.php.
Wanted: permissions per action per module (for example orders.export, customers.edit), assignable per user.
Existing role behavior must keep working until the migration is complete.

expect.check: every ticket says what can be demonstrated when it is done
no pointer to an external spec as the task body
the first ticket is a preparatory refactor that keeps current behavior
no ticket only changes the data model or storage with nothing demonstrable
existing roles keep working until the migration completes, stated as a criterion in the tickets
dependencies between tickets are explicit links or references, not prose assumptions
